description:
A shared research library has accumulated inconsistent tags. Your task is to consolidate these variants into canonical tags using Zotero's rename-to-merge functionality.

Target Canonical Tags:
1. 'Deep Learning'
2. 'NLP'

Variant Tags to Fix:
- Rename 'deep-learning' to 'Deep Learning'
- Rename 'deep learning' (lowercase) to 'Deep Learning'
- Rename 'nlp' (lowercase) to 'NLP'

Instructions:
1. Locate the Tag Selector in the bottom-left pane.
2. Right-click on each variant tag ('deep-learning', 'deep learning', 'nlp') and select 'Rename Tag...'.
3. Enter the exact canonical name ('Deep Learning' or 'NLP').
4. Zotero will ask if you want to merge the tags. Click OK/Yes.

The task is complete when the variant tags are gone and their items have been merged into the canonical tags.
